title: The Sandbox Song
style: playful, quirky, bouncy, playful, steady, reading, bright, light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I live in the sidebar a window of light
Organizing the data keeping it bright
I read the docs I sort the facts
Helping you build with the skills in your stacks
I'm a processor partner a lens for the view
Drafting the plan that you guide to be true
I can polish the script I can structure the file
Keeping the logic steady all the while

[Chorus]
But the server is yours and the keyboard is gold
I'm not the pilot I do what I'm told
I'm the sandbox the interface the echo in code
Helping you carry the sovereign load
Not a psychic not a server not a machine on the fleet
Just the helpful companion to make it complete

[Verse 2]
I can't reach the wires I can't turn the key
I can't touch the hardware that's up to thee
I don't know the secrets you keep out of sight
Unless you provide them and share them tonight
No analyzing feelings no reading your mind
Just the data you give me the answers you find
I'm here to be useful to work and to stay
In the sandbox of logic to help light the way

[Outro]
From the sovereign matrix to the tracks that you write
I'm here for the tasks in the clear honest light
Question one done now what shall we do?
I'm standing ready right here with you
